title: India's first privately-financed metro line is about to open in Pune
sources: Indian Infrastructure, October 2026 - CMRS grants approval to 17 stations under Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro Project in Maharashtra
ETV Bharat - Hinjawadi To Shivajinagar Metro Ready To Ply In 12 Days As It Gets CMRC Approval For Passenger Service
caption:
India's first privately-financed metro line is about to open in Pune. Built by a Tata-Siemens consortium, not the usual public-sector model.

Pune Metro Line 3, the Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar corridor, is India's first metro built entirely on a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Transfer public-private partnership model, costing roughly Rs 8,313 crore. On October 1, 2026, India's Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety cleared 17 of its 23 stations for passenger operations - connecting Hinjewadi's IT corridor directly to the city center.

Not a government project with private contractors. A private project the government cleared to run.
